title: 3권 스토리북 · sb3_end
prompt: Flat vector illustration in the style of a modern children's English textbook: simple geometric shapes, bold flat solid colors, at most one flat darker shadow tone per object, clean smooth edges with no outlines or only very thin dark outlines, rounded friendly forms, no texture, no gradients, no watercolor, no paper grain, no photo-realism, no 3D render. Bright cheerful palette (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, sky blue). Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image. Full illustrated scene: the background is made of a few large flat color shapes (ground, bushes, sky) with a calm plain sky area near the top, characters large and clearly visible. No text, no letters. Do NOT draw any speech bubbles, thought bubbles or empty white balloons of any kind. Letter trees are ordinary round leafy trees with small fruits (like an orchard); never shape trees, clouds, paths or any object like letters of the alphabet. Full-page picture-book illustration. Use the attached character sheet ONLY to copy how the characters look. Draw ONLY these characters: Pip, Bun, Hedgie, Grumble, Beads, Pim & Pam. Every other character on the sheet must NOT appear in this picture. Scene: Final page: evening at the far edge of the Pair Forest. Pip, Pim and Pam, Bun, Hedgie, Beads and Grumble sit in a row on a fallen log seen from behind, looking out over a moonlit valley toward a tall castle on a far hill; on its big gate a short glowing word shimmers as a tiny sparkling e appears at its end (the letters c, a, p and e are the ONLY text allowed in the picture); Grumble's lantern hangs on a stick beside them like a star and the crab's drum rests at his feet; behind them the open round doors glow along the forest path. Calm and warm. Characters: Pip is a small round yellow baby songbird standing on tiny orange feet, big sparkling black eyes with rosy cheeks, a cowlick of three little feathers on top of the head, a cream-colored belly patch shaped like a musical note, short stubby wings held like little arms, a small orange beak closed shyly, wearing a single small green leaf tied around its neck like a scarf. Bun is a small white rabbit standing on two legs, one long ear flopped down, green rain boots, brave smile. Hedgie is a small hedgehog standing on two legs, soft spikes with one tiny flower stuck in them, curious cautious eyes. Grumble is a grumpy old raccoon standing on two legs, dark eye mask, a striped nightcap, holding a tiny candle lantern in one paw, frowning sleepily, slippers. Beads is a small friendly caterpillar whose body is a string of five round beads in rainbow colors (red, orange, yellow, green, blue), big round sparkling eyes, two tiny antennae tipped with little beads, a cheerful open smile, no letters on the beads. Pim & Pam is two tiny twin bluebirds always side by side, one with a small red feather tuft and one with a small yellow feather tuft, round sky-blue bodies with white bellies, big shiny black eyes, tiny orange beaks, their inner wingtips touching, drawn together as one pair, no letters anywhere.
